description: Reports whether the Ui.Vision browser extension is currently connected to this bridge. Call this first if other tools fail — it tells you whether the extension side panel is open and the bridge is enabled in its settings. Several browsers can be connected at once; the status lists each one by label (chrome#1, firefox#1, ... — or a name the user set in Settings > AI, e.g. work-chrome) and marks the ACTIVE one that tool calls go to.
name: bridge_status
